service.description: Extract HotWax OMS orders for an automation window and write normalized JSON output to the automation data-manager folder.

parameter.name: automationExecutionId
parameter.description: Automation execution id used to choose the default data-manager output folder.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: Trusted automation owner tenant. When present, config access is checked against this tenant instead of a user-session active tenant.

parameter.name: windowStart
parameter.description: Start of the automation window; accepts Timestamp, Date, ISO-8601 text, SQL timestamp text, or epoch milliseconds.

parameter.name: windowEnd
parameter.description: End of the automation window; accepts Timestamp, Date, ISO-8601 text, SQL timestamp text, or epoch milliseconds.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional output file name. Defaults to oms-orders-{fromMillis}-{thruMillis}.json.

parameter.name: keepRecordFields
parameter.description: Optional projection: top-level record fields to keep in the output file. When present, each order is trimmed to these fields after reconciliation filtering and before writing (callers compute the list from the rule set's join-key and rule fields plus the display fields). Absent means full untrimmed records (backward compatible).

parameter.name: reconciliationRunResultId
parameter.description: Optional observability run id. With expectedRecordCount, the extractor heartbeats page-by-page progress (recordCount + progressPercent) onto the run's RUNNING extract step so the UI can show live percent. Advisory only.

parameter.name: expectedRecordCount
parameter.description: Optional expected total for progress percent — typically the other side's extracted record count for the same window.

parameter.name: exchangeManifestFileLocation
parameter.description: Location of the exchange-manifest sidecar written when the window contained excluded exchange orders; null otherwise. Identities/amounts only, capped at 500 entries.
